mobbin:9e0d5df7-8fea-4a21-9032-7a84de9d1.summary: From an open Doc, the user opens Templates, chooses 'Save as Template', fills in the details, saves, and sees a success message with a link to Template Center.
steps: Doc editor with Project Overview open
Templates side panel with 'Save as Template'
Short message: template created; link to Template Center
steal: The save pop-up has 'Share with' choices: 'All members', 'Only me', 'Select people', 'Admins only', and 'Everyone (incl. guests)', with public sharing off by default.
The footer offers 'Update an existing Template' or 'Save as new' in the same pop-up.
'Save Template' stays disabled until the template is named, and the empty field gets a red border.
The success message names the template and links 'Open in Template Center'.
avoid: A public sharing switch that creates an outside link is too open for clinical scenarios, which are the center's own work.
mobbin:9e0d5df7-8fea-4a21-9032-7a84de9d1.fit: Scenario manager: add 'save as template' with access set per template (private, chosen people, or the whole organization). That is simpler than today's unclear SCE permissions.

mobbin:456a85db-8ced-4de2-b541-c685bca7e.summary: On a task detail, the user creates a checklist, adds items with per-item assignees, sees progress 0/N and a 'Use Template' option, alongside assigned comments and attachments.
steps: Empty Checklists section and 'New checklist item'
steal: Each checklist row has its own assignee, so tasks can be split between roles such as the sim tech and faculty.
The section header shows progress ('Checklists 0/N') and a filter for the items assigned to you ('N for me').
'Use Template' sits beside 'Add checklist', so a set of items can be reused on other tasks.
'+ New checklist item' adds a row without leaving the task.
avoid: There is no scoring, no required flag and no rubric weighting, which is too thin for learner evaluation checklists.
mobbin:456a85db-8ced-4de2-b541-c685bca7e.fit: Scenario manager: extend the cut-down Case Manager checklist with assignees and reusable templates. Essentials evaluations would still need scoring and a set time for filling them in, and this does not cover QR without login.

mobbin:e17ac016-5f41-4926-bdbc-525e0a847.summary: From a space Overview, the user opens Automations, builds a When/Then rule, creates it, and manages it with an on/off switch.
steps: Small menu: Active 0 and Add Automation presets
Builder: When task created, then Set Custom Field
Manage: Active rule with on/off switch
steal: The When/Then blocks are summed up in one plain sentence under the work area.
A warning appears right away when an action will be skipped because the assignee lacks access.
The assignee picker includes roles that fill themselves in, such as 'Task creator', 'Triggered by' and 'Watchers'.
After a rule is created, the Manage tab shows how many rules are active or inactive, with an on/off switch for each.
avoid: Full libraries of integrations and rule catalogs across many categories are heavier than the few defaults a scenario needs (auto-record, prep email, announcements).
mobbin:e17ac016-5f41-4926-bdbc-525e0a847.fit: Scenario manager: turn today's auto-record, email and announcement settings on scheduling templates into a clear When/Then panel of defaults per scenario. Keep the presets few; this is not a general automation product.
